generate_subtitles_course: generate SRT subtitles for all course playlist videos in a given language and save to disk
generate_subtitles_task: generate SRT subtitles for all task playlist videos in a given language and save to disk
run_generate_subtitles_cli: run the CLI tool with --language flag to generate subtitles for both course and task playlists
summarize_generate_subtitles: summarize the generate_subtitles function which fetches YouTube transcripts, translates them, and writes SRT files
review_generate_subtitles: review the generate_subtitles function for error handling when transcripts fail to fetch or translate
